name: Manika
source:
"For lunch, we all head to a nearby family restaurant together...

We eat ice cream...

Ah! If only summer vacation could last forever!"

A high school girl android. She possesses an undying love for soccer, and is an active member of the school's soccer club, excelling as a midfielder.

She is spirited and has a tomboyish streak, yet she is also a bit of a airhead... and she is absolutely terrible at her studies.

Because her limbs are encased in a hard outer shell, the physical strain of club activities causes it to crack frequently.
